# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/report-to-pdf.sh. test-report-pdf.sh runs each one in a working directory
# that holds the run directories audit_1 (with a REPORT.md) and incident_1 (made by rundir.sh), the symbolic
# link audit_2 (to audit_1), and audit_3, a directory with a REPORT.md but no .gitignore, with stand-ins for
# pandoc and the TeX engines on PATH.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each case prints
# nothing on stdout, runs no pandoc and changes nothing in the working directory.
